input_cost.implication: The directory contains 513 current IDs, consuming 60%-73% of each initial definition request. The batch input limit excludes this directory.
input_cost.recommendation: Bound the entire rendered input, compact the shared directory and supply the selected concept family plus relevant confirmed definitions; keep every source in the requested family covered.

utf8_transport.cause: Each Buffer is decoded separately before concatenation, so an UTF-8 character split between TCP chunks is replaced by U+FFFD.

utf8_transport.recommendation: Collect Buffer chunks under a byte limit then decode once, or use a streaming UTF-8 decoder; add a chunk-boundary regression. Not implemented in this frozen attempt.

python_sdk.policy: Connection failures, 408,409,429,5xx can retry; 422 length errors are not retried by this status policy.

definition_repair_loop.scope: Validation repair only; an inference exception escapes this loop.

application_error_loss.behavior: Inference failure becomes generic InferenceRuntimeError then a generic retryable-looking task message; the main Pi receives status:error without a stable error classification or blocked same-input fingerprint.

main_pi_repeat.bounds: Not literally infinite: the task has a two-hour limit and max tool calls. Within those limits the same failed request can be regenerated.

retry_layers.recommendation: Assign one retry budget, preserve timeout/truncation/validation error codes through every layer, reject same-input repetition unless configuration or partition changes, and terminate sibling inferences when the stage cannot complete.

timeout_120s.known_abort_path: server/model-bridge.ts:23 aborts its signal when the HTTP client disconnects; provider marks aborted only when its supplied signal is aborted.
timeout_120s.note: server/config.ts runtime.timeoutSeconds=120 controls analysis tools; it is not passed to this model call. Do not claim this setting caused the observed abort.
